title: Measured best-of-k criticality-partitioned gate cloning (critical-sink replica + stock van Ginneken on tolerant sinks) for shared high-fanout drivers in the post-stock recovery phase
hypothesis: Shared high-fanout drivers on violating paths (Ibex AND2_X1 _26153_ with 943 loads on all ten worst paths; JPEG fanout 12-17 launch drivers) make every critical path pay the full net load, and the stock spatial 2-way clone or single-buffer split never restructures them; iteration 17's lumped-RC tree prefilter applied zero trees. Instead, in runTnsRecovery only, explicitly schedule drivers with fanout >=12, sort sinks by required time, and generate up to 6 atomic variants: a critical-only upsized replica (top 5/15/30% of sinks) or an m-way required-time-quantile clone split (m=2..4), with the tolerant net rebuffered by the stock Rebuffer::rebufferNet. Every variant is evaluated by journaled incremental STA and the best design-TNS variant is kept only if it satisfies a ratcheting WNS floor, a per-endpoint guard (pre-move slack > -1 ps must stay > -1 ps) and no new DRV. Cloning removes load from critical sinks without adding a buffer stage, so deep (33-37 stage) Ibex paths gain tens of ps at the shared stage across thousands of endpoints while measured selection avoids the model/STA mismatch of iterations 15 and 17.

evaluator.lesson: Iteration 18 lost to champion because visit-dependent single-replica cloning did not implement the proposed atomic search, while Ibex's 943-load attributed driver belongs to the launch clock path rather than the data chain.
evaluator.dead_end: Do not repeat same-strength critical-fraction clone rotation without isolated atomic evaluation and verified data-path targeting.
good_changes: src/rsz/src/policy/SetupLegacyPolicy.cc: journaled STA evaluates measured WNS and TNS, but its benefit is inherited and does not establish a gain from iteration 18
src/rsz/src/move/CloneGenerator.cc: counters establish variant generation, though they do not measure committed moves
bad_changes: src/rsz/src/move/CloneGenerator.cc: shared visit-dependent state changes clone proposals outside an explicit recovery-only search
src/rsz/src/move/CloneGenerator.cc: same-strength single-replica fractions omit upsizing, multiway splitting and tolerant-net rebuffering
src/rsz/src/policy/SetupLegacyPolicy.cc: fixed WNS floor and aggregate-TNS acceptance omit the proposed endpoint guard and best-variant comparison
